# Fixture for tests/space_weather_density_accelerometer_oracle.rs

`windows_j71.csv` holds orbit-window averages derived from third-party measurements. It is
built by `make_fixture.py` (`make_fixture.py DNS_DIR --j71 > windows_j71.csv`; without `--j71`
the generator writes the four-field points the first run used, byte-identical to the first
four fields of every point here). Only derived numbers are committed, never the source files.

## Sources (retrieved 2026-10-02)

- Thermosphere mass density: TOLEOS (Thermosphere Observations from Low-Earth Orbiting
  Satellites) DNSxACC_2 daily products of CHAMP, GRACE-A and GRACE-FO 1, produced by Delft
  University of Technology with CNES, DLR and the University of Bonn under the ESA (European
  Space Agency) Swarm DISC (Data, Innovation and Science Cluster); format: TOLEOS Product
  Definition Document SW-TN-DUT-GS-129_01 revision 3 (2022-07-12). Downloaded from
  https://swarm-diss.eo.esa.int/ (`?do=download&file=swarm/Multimission/...`). ESA Earth
  observation data, free and open access under the ESA data policy, with attribution to ESA
  and the TOLEOS team. Days of year 5, 15, ..., 365 of CHAMP 2001 (37 files), GRACE-A 2002 (21
  files; the server holds none before 2002-04-04), GRACE-A 2008 (37), GRACE-FO 1 2019 (37) and
  GRACE-FO 1 2024 (37); no selected day was missing on the server apart from GRACE-A 2002
  before its first file. SHA-256 of every file is listed below.
- Space-weather indices: GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences,
  `Kp_ap_Ap_SN_F107_since_1932.txt` from https://kp.gfz.de/app/files/ (CC BY 4.0; Matzka et
  al. 2021, doi 10.1029/2020SW002641), SHA-256
  cfd3c7dcf021f1d4125f8ecc71a8c5edcb13efe228d111fead95b628e3ba5b4e on the retrieval date (the
  file grows daily).

## Columns

`campaign,phase,start_utc,mean_alt_km,n_valid,measured_mean,points`; `measured_mean` is the
mean of the window's valid native-rate `density` samples (kg/m^3); `points` is a `;`-separated
list of `alt_m:f107:f107a:kp:lat_deg:lst_h:mjd` at the valid samples on whole five-minute marks.
